purpose.primary: Describe the information environment associated with cumulative selfish-action outcomes under the current objective.
purpose.secondary: Separate broad exploratory associations in saved optimization trials from paired fixed-condition comparisons.
not_in_scope: reselecting or tuning the Stage 8 candidates
claiming that an observed information metric causally changed selfish action

additional_experiment.candidate_policy: Run only the predesignated primary candidate for each network. Do not use Stage 10 results to change candidate identity, rank, or parameters.

stage2_saved_trials.interpretation: Exploratory association only because optimization methods sampled the design space adaptively and the simulator seed was fixed.

stage4_fixed_confirmation.prior_high_policy: Use only the corrected existing-CSV runs; never use the original generated prior_high runs.

information_definition.num_fst_viewed_note: Count of first accesses to information objects, not a count of unique viewing agents.
information_definition.normalization: Divide counts by the number of agents and simulation iterations when comparing runs across networks.

ratio.name: corrective_to_misinformation
ratio.zero_denominator_policy: Return missing for the ratio and report the zero-denominator count together with numerator and denominator.

exploratory_information_indicators: all four information labels for shared_per_agent_iteration and viewed_per_agent_iteration
stage2: Spearman associations between certainty/effectiveness and information indicators
Spearman associations between information indicators and Jcum/Jpeak
rank-residual partial correlations between information indicators and outcomes controlling certainty and effectiveness
random-search results as primary and all-method results as sensitivity
Benjamini-Hochberg q-values as supplementary output; interpret effect direction and cross-network consistency first
fixed_confirmation: paired comparisons of none, legacy_balance, corrected prior_high, and the frozen primary candidate
hierarchical paired percentile bootstrap over simulator-seed blocks and iterations
separate cumulative behavior and cumulative information time series without dual axes
interpretation_limits: Information indicators are post-intervention response indicators, not independently manipulated causes.
A large corrective-to-misinformation ratio is not promoted to a design variable or optimization objective.
Lower behavior-guiding diffusion is not interpreted as intrinsically desirable.
A smaller diffusion count does not imply that an information type is unnecessary.
Facebook primary-candidate results remain exploratory because Stage 7 found no qualified candidate.
